description: This file contains customizations and extensions for invoice and invoice line models in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including methods for refund processing, tax calculations, and subtotal computations with tax inclusion/exclusion handling.

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extension of the 'account.invoice' model with additional fields and refund method.

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Extension of the 'account.invoice.line' model with custom subtotal calculations and price unit defaults.

classes.name: account_invoice_tax
classes.description: Extension of the 'account.invoice.tax' model with custom tax computation logic.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Creates a refund invoice and preserves the original price_type.

methods.name: _amount_line2
methods.description: Calculates subtotal amounts considering tax inclusion/exclusion based on price_type.

methods.name: _price_unit_default
methods.description: Provides default unit price, adjusting for total check context.

methods.name: _get_invoice
methods.description: Retrieves invoice line IDs for a given invoice.

methods.name: move_line_get_item
methods.description: Prepares move line data for accounting entries.

methods.name: product_id_change_unit_price_inv
methods.description: Adjusts unit price based on whether tax is included.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Overrides product change to include price_type context.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Calculates grouped tax amounts for an invoice, considering tax signs and currency conversions.
